name: USAF aide de camp aiguillette cord (silver, single loop, chrome tip)
size_basis: Not dimensioned in CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903. Shoulder run 4.2 in matches the garment shoulder seam; loop length ~7.4 in and tip ~1.15 in are estimates of a ceremonial single-loop aiguillette
provenance: in-house construction from DAFI 36-2903 10.7.7.1 ("silver, single loop, chrome tip with raised wing and star emblem"); same braid as the shoulder cords

dimensions.form: aiguillette, single loop with chrome tip
dimensions.orientation: top run lies along the left shoulder seam (arm end at the right of the asset, neck end at the left); the loop then hangs down the chest

garment_fit.note: strap axis = line from the neck end to the arm end of the garment's left epaulet strap / shoulder strip (garment user units, 0.01 in; wearer's left shoulder is on the viewer's right). Place: centre the cord on the axis with shoulder_seam_attach_neck_end at the neck end, rotate so the neck->arm anchors follow the axis, shift the chord 0.125 in toward the neck side so the 0.25 in bow is centred on the strap; draw order garment, layers, cord, then the epaulet sleeve/strip over it

class_b_shirt.note: epaulet_left landmark: pointed neck end to the mid of the arm end

class_b_blouse_female.note: epaulet_left landmark: pointed neck end to the mid of the arm end

mounts.uniform: USAF-style service and service dress (Class A / Class B) - aides de camp to general officers (senior and cadet)
mounts.rule: worn on the left sleeve/shoulder only while acting as an aide de camp; open end grounded under the epaulet at the left shoulder seam (CAPR 39-1 9.3.4; DAFI 36-2903 10.7.7.1)
